label: Dpd system
definition: A phage defense system in which an organism possesses a Dpd genomic island whose dpdA-K genes install 7-deazaguanine derivatives into DNA and are modeled by DefenseFinder as a multi-profile Dpd system.
observations: Dpd branch under phage defense system; distinct from individual dpdA-K genes, Dpd proteins, FolE/QueC/QueD/QueE proteins, 7-deazaguanine or preQ0 biosynthesis enzymes, 7-deazaguanine deoxynucleosides, DefenseFinder HMM profiles, source database rows naming one Dpd component, unresolved Dpd restriction outputs, and other phage defense systems.
